verses.1: The understanding of David. A prayer, when he was in the cave.
verses.2: With my voice, I cried out to the Lord. With my voice, I made supplication to the Lord.
verses.3: In his sight, I pour out my prayer, and before him, I declare my tribulation.
verses.4: Though my spirit may become faint within me, even then, you have known my paths. Along this way, which I have been walking, they have hidden a snare for me.
verses.5: I considered toward the right, and I looked, but there was no one who would know me. Flight has perished before me, and there is no one who has concern for my soul.
verses.6: I cried out to you, O Lord. I said: You are my hope, my portion in the land of the living.
verses.7: Attend to my supplication. For I have been humbled exceedingly. Free me from my persecutors, for they have been fortified against me.
verses.8: Lead my soul out of confinement in order to confess your name. The just are waiting for me, until you repay me. [ Psalm 142 ] (143)
